title: Kogan Google TV (Changhong-built CHiQ AI PONT, product GTVU65KG, device dangni), Google TV 14 (API 34),
header:
Kogan Google TV (Changhong-built CHiQ AI PONT, product GTVU65KG, device dangni), Google TV 14 (API 34),
firmware UKN3.250415.047.A1, security patch 2025-05-01, MediaTek mt5867, Australia.
1 GB RAM (MemTotal about 930 MB). ro.product.brand Kogan, vendor brand CHiQ, manufacturer Changhong.
Same board as examples/chiq-gtvu65 on a newer UKN3 firmware; the Kogan boot logo is in firmware and
/product/media/bootanimation.zip, read-only without root.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/kogan-gtvu65kg/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/kogan-gtvu65kg/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Debloat only: the stock Google TV home (com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx) stays, so setupwraith and
the MediaTek partnercustomizer stay too. For the launcher half, follow examples/chiq-gtvu65.
Already disabled from the factory: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter.plus.

Tested on one set the same day, not a multi-day soak: after each batch Home opens, the Input key opens
the switcher with Live TV, AV, HDMI 1 (ARC) and HDMI 2, and Netflix launches. After a reboot the list
stays disabled, Home is launcherx and the crash buffer is empty.
AdGuard Private DNS (dns.adguard-dns.com) validates on this firmware.

KEEP, even though the names look like bloat:
- com.homwee.mmp.screenshare (/product/app/CH_AirPlay) and com.homwee.multiscreenshare: the AirPlay
receiver, so iPhones can cast. Disable only if nobody uses AirPlay.
- com.google.android.apps.mediashell: Chromecast.
- com.homwee.upgrade and com.homwee.dmt.upgrade: firmware updates.
- com.mediatek.autopair, com.homwee.factory, com.homwee.dynamicbacklight and the TV services, as in
examples/chiq-gtvu65.

apps.note: re-enable if you use the screen reader
